about.description: I’m On Thanh Dat, a Unity/C# developer working across mobile games and playable ads. I turn gameplay ideas into responsive, readable experiences: rhythm systems, puzzle rules, progression, and the feedback that makes a player try again. My work spans prototyping, mobile optimization, release, and creative testing at MOPA GAMES, Amanotes, and Supercent Vietnam.

skills.title: Unity / C#
skills.desc: Prototype a mechanic, wire up its rules, and tune it into a playable 2D/3D loop.

skills.title: Rhythm Game Design
skills.desc: Line up input windows and feedback with the beat.

skills.title: Mobile Optimization
skills.desc: Target stable 60 fps with object pooling and batching on mobile hardware.

skills.title: DOTween / Animation
skills.desc: Use timing, Spine, and procedural motion to make every action read clearly.

skills.title: Puzzle & Idle Design
skills.desc: Shape level goals and progression so each move is clear and the next one beckons.

skills.title: Data-Driven Iteration
skills.desc: Frame A/B tests around a hypothesis; use CPI results to shape the next playable.

skillGroups.title: Build
skillGroups.description: Build a clear goal, satisfying controls, and a loop that makes players want another run.

skillGroups.title: Game Feel
skillGroups.description: Sync taps, VFX, and animation to the beat so each hit lands with rhythm and reads clearly.

skillGroups.title: Ship & Improve
skillGroups.description: Keep the build smooth on a phone, then use test results to choose what to tune next.
skillGroups.project: Cat Dash: Cute Cat Music Game

timeline.desc: Developing mobile games and Playable Ads with Unity and C#. Researching trends, shaping concepts, and building engaging games optimized for smooth play on mobile devices.

Developed Unity/C# Playable Ads across rhythm and casual genres, researching trends and turning gameplay concepts into engaging ads. Contributed to creative ideation and content creation, prototyped quickly, and optimized performance for mobile devices. Helped deliver Amanotes' first 3D rhythm playable.
Developed and shipped hyper-casual mobile games, turning simple ideas into fast, readable, replayable loops from prototype to Google Play release.
